QuestionStmt.S: Identify the correct decreasing order of stability of complexes formed by divalent metal ions with same ligand.

Solution.S:
According to the Irving–Williams order for high-spin octahedral complexes of divalent metal ions with the same ligand:

$$\mathrm{Mn^{2+} < Fe^{2+} < Co^{2+} < Ni^{2+} < Cu^{2+} > Zn^{2+}}$$

Cd²⁺ lies below Zn²⁺ and forms less stable complexes than Mn²⁺. Thus the stability order for Mn²⁺, Cu²⁺, and Cd²⁺ is:

$$\mathrm{Cu^{2+} > Mn^{2+} > Cd^{2+}}$$

This corresponds to option A.
